titre: Exercices — L'irréel et les hypothèses (conditionnels mixtes)
consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 1 : « If you (to touch) that wire, you (to get) an electric shock. »
corrige: Proposition en if → présent : touch.
Conséquence probable → will + BV : will get.
exercices.reponse: If you touch that wire, you will get an electric shock.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 2 : « If I (to be) you, I (to accept) the offer. »
corrige: Irréel du présent → prétérit, et were à toutes les personnes : were.
Principale → would + BV : would accept.
exercices.reponse: If I were you, I would accept the offer.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 3 : « If she (to take) the earlier flight, she (not / to be) stuck here. »
corrige: Proposition en if → past perfect : had taken.
Principale → would have + PP : wouldn't have been.
exercices.reponse: If she had taken the earlier flight, she wouldn't have been stuck here.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la faute : « If I would have more money, I would buy a house. »
corrige: On n'emploie jamais would dans la proposition en if.
Type 2 → prétérit : If I had more money.
exercices.reponse: If I had more money, I would buy a house.

exercices.enonce: Construis un mixte passé→présent : « I didn't learn to drive. (conséquence maintenant : I can't get to work easily.) »
corrige: Condition passée → past perfect : If I had learned to drive.
Conséquence présente → would + BV : I would get to work more easily now.
exercices.reponse: If I had learned to drive, I would get to work more easily now.

exercices.enonce: Exprime un regret présent : « I don't speak Chinese. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Regret sur le présent → wish + prétérit.
I wish I spoke Chinese.
exercices.reponse: I wish I spoke Chinese.

exercices.enonce: Exprime un regret passé : « I sold my old bike. Now I regret it. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Regret sur le passé → wish + past perfect.
I wish I hadn't sold my old bike.
exercices.reponse: I wish I hadn't sold my old bike.

exercices.enonce: Exprime l'agacement : « My neighbour plays loud music every night. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Souhait de changement de comportement d'autrui → wish + would.
I wish my neighbour would stop playing loud music.
exercices.reponse: I wish my neighbour would stop playing loud music.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Il est grand temps que tu prennes une décision » et « Je préférerais que tu ne partes pas ».
corrige: It's (high) time + prétérit : It's high time you made a decision.
would rather + sujet + prétérit : I'd rather you didn't leave.
exercices.reponse: It's high time you made a decision. / I'd rather you didn't leave.

exercices.enonce: Relie réel et irréel : « He was rude, so I didn't help him. Rewrite as a type 3 sentence expressing what would have changed. »
corrige: Condition passée → past perfect : If he hadn't been so rude.
Conséquence passée → would have + PP : I would have helped him.
exercices.reponse: If he hadn't been so rude, I would have helped him.

exercices.enonce: Identifie le type de conditionnel : « If you heat ice, it melts. » Type 0, 1, 2 ou 3 ?
corrige: Les deux propositions sont au présent simple.
Il s'agit d'une vérité générale : c'est le type 0.
exercices.reponse: Type 0

exercices.enonce: Identifie le type : « If I had more time, I'd travel. » Type 1, 2 ou 3 ?
corrige: Proposition en if au prétérit, principale en would + BV.
C'est l'irréel du présent : type 2.
exercices.reponse: Type 2

exercices.enonce: Identifie le type : « If I had known, I'd have come. » Type 1, 2 ou 3 ?
corrige: Proposition en if au past perfect (had known), principale en would have + PP.
C'est l'irréel du passé : type 3.
exercices.reponse: Type 3

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 1 : « If it (to rain) tomorrow, we (to stay) at home. »
corrige: Proposition en if → présent : rains (3e personne du singulier, donc -s).
Conséquence probable → will + BV : will stay.
exercices.reponse: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 2 : « If she (to live) closer, she (to visit) us more often. »
corrige: Irréel du présent → prétérit dans la proposition en if : lived.
Principale → would + BV : would visit.
exercices.reponse: If she lived closer, she would visit us more often.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 2 avec la forme soignée de be : « If he (to be) taller, he (to play) basketball. »
corrige: Au type 2, be devient were à toutes les personnes en anglais soigné.
Principale → would + BV : would play.
exercices.reponse: If he were taller, he would play basketball.

exercices.enonce: Transforme la réalité en hypothèse (type 2) : « I don't have a car, so I can't drive you. »
corrige: On inverse la réalité : don't have → had (prétérit modal).
Conséquence → would + BV : I would drive you.
exercices.reponse: If I had a car, I would drive you.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 3 : « If we (to leave) earlier, we (to catch) the train. »
corrige: Proposition en if → past perfect : had left.
Principale → would have + PP : would have caught (caught est le participe passé de catch).
exercices.reponse: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

exercices.enonce: Transforme en type 3 : « They didn't book a table, so they had to wait for an hour. »
corrige: On inverse la réalité passée : didn't book → had booked.
Conséquence passée inversée : had to wait → wouldn't have had to wait.
exercices.reponse: If they had booked a table, they wouldn't have had to wait for an hour.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la faute : « If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the match. »
corrige: Jamais will dans la proposition en if.
Type 1 → présent : If it rains.
exercices.reponse: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the match.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la faute : « If I would have known, I would have called you. »
corrige: Jamais would dans la proposition en if.
Irréel du passé → past perfect : If I had known.
exercices.reponse: If I had known, I would have called you.

exercices.enonce: Exprime un regret présent : « I'm not tall enough to reach the shelf. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Regret sur le présent → wish + prétérit.
Avec be, on emploie were (ou was en anglais courant).
exercices.reponse: I wish I were tall enough to reach the shelf. (I wish I was… est aussi accepté)

exercices.enonce: Exprime un regret présent avec if only : « I can't swim. → If only ___ ! »
corrige: Regret sur le présent → if only + prétérit.
Le prétérit de can est could.
exercices.reponse: If only I could swim!

exercices.enonce: Exprime un regret passé : « I didn't take my umbrella this morning. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Regret sur le passé → wish + past perfect.
didn't take → had taken.
exercices.reponse: I wish I had taken my umbrella this morning.

exercices.enonce: Complète : « It's time we (to go) home. »
corrige: Après It's time + sujet, on emploie le prétérit.
go → went.
exercices.reponse: It's time we went home.

exercices.enonce: Complète : « I'd rather you (not / to tell) anyone about it. »
corrige: would rather + sujet + prétérit pour une préférence sur l'action d'autrui.
Forme négative au prétérit : didn't tell.
exercices.reponse: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about it.

exercices.enonce: Identifie le type de conditionnel mixte : « If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now. »
corrige: Condition au past perfect (passé) ; conséquence en would + BV avec now (présent).
C'est un mixte passé → présent.
exercices.reponse: Mixte passé → présent

exercices.enonce: Identifie le type de conditionnel mixte : « If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken to her. »
corrige: Condition au prétérit (trait de caractère actuel) ; conséquence en would have + PP (événement passé).
C'est un mixte présent → passé.
exercices.reponse: Mixte présent → passé

exercices.enonce: Construis un mixte passé → présent : « She missed the bus this morning. (Conséquence maintenant : she isn't here.) »
corrige: Condition passée → past perfect : If she hadn't missed the bus.
Conséquence présente → would + BV : she would be here now.
exercices.reponse: If she hadn't missed the bus this morning, she would be here now.

exercices.enonce: Construis un mixte présent → passé : « He doesn't speak Spanish, so he didn't understand the guide yesterday. »
corrige: Condition présente (fait permanent) → prétérit : If he spoke Spanish.
Conséquence passée → would have + PP : he would have understood the guide yesterday.
exercices.reponse: If he spoke Spanish, he would have understood the guide yesterday.

exercices.enonce: Exprime l'agacement : « My brother always borrows my clothes without asking. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Souhait de changement de comportement d'autrui → wish + would.
On peut écrire would stop borrowing ou wouldn't borrow.
exercices.reponse: I wish my brother would stop borrowing my clothes without asking. (ou : I wish my brother wouldn't borrow my clothes without asking.)

exercices.enonce: Corrige la faute : « I wish it will stop raining. »
corrige: Jamais de futur (will) après wish.
Souhait qu'une situation change → wish + would.
exercices.reponse: I wish it would stop raining.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la faute : « I wish I have more free time. »
corrige: Après wish, on recule le temps : regret présent → prétérit.
have → had.
exercices.reponse: I wish I had more free time.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la faute : « I wish I didn't say that yesterday. »
corrige: yesterday indique un regret sur le passé.
Regret passé → wish + past perfect : hadn't said.
exercices.reponse: I wish I hadn't said that yesterday.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Si j'avais su, je serais venu. »
corrige: « Si j'avais su » = irréel du passé → past perfect : If I had known.
« je serais venu » → would have + PP : I would have come.
exercices.reponse: If I had known, I would have come.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Si j'étais toi, je ne dirais rien. »
corrige: Irréel du présent → If I were you.
Principale → would + BV à la forme négative : I wouldn't say anything.
exercices.reponse: If I were you, I wouldn't say anything.

exercices.enonce: Choisis la bonne forme : « If you (studied / had studied) harder last year, you would have passed the exam. »
corrige: La principale est en would have + PP et last year situe la condition dans le passé.
Irréel du passé → past perfect.
exercices.reponse: had studied

exercices.enonce: Corrige la faute : « It's high time you go to bed. »
corrige: Après It's (high) time + sujet, on emploie le prétérit.
go → went.
exercices.reponse: It's high time you went to bed.

exercices.enonce: Choisis le type qui convient et complète : « If the weather (to be) nice tomorrow, we (to have) a picnic. » (C'est tout à fait possible.)
corrige: Situation possible dans le futur → type 1.
Présent dans la proposition en if (is), will + BV dans la principale (will have).
exercices.reponse: If the weather is nice tomorrow, we will have a picnic.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Je regrette de ne pas être allé au concert. » (avec I wish)
corrige: Regret sur le passé → wish + past perfect.
« ne pas être allé » → hadn't gone.
exercices.reponse: I wish I had gone to the concert.

exercices.enonce: Traduis avec if only : « Si seulement je connaissais la réponse ! »
corrige: Regret sur le présent → if only + prétérit.
know → knew.
exercices.reponse: If only I knew the answer!

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Je préférerais que vous restiez dîner. »
corrige: Préférence sur l'action d'autrui → would rather + sujet + prétérit.
stay → stayed.
exercices.reponse: I'd rather you stayed for dinner.

exercices.enonce: Complète ce mixte : « If I (to accept) that job in London last year, I (to live) in England now. »
corrige: Condition passée (last year) → past perfect : had accepted.
Conséquence présente (now) → would + BV : would be living (ou would live).
exercices.reponse: If I had accepted that job in London last year, I would be living in England now. (would live est aussi accepté)

exercices.enonce: Complète ce mixte : « If she (not / to be) so stubborn, she (to listen) to our advice last week. »
corrige: Condition présente (trait de caractère) → prétérit : weren't (ou wasn't).
Conséquence passée (last week) → would have + PP : would have listened.
exercices.reponse: If she weren't so stubborn, she would have listened to our advice last week. (If she wasn't… est aussi accepté)

exercices.enonce: Explique le sens de « If I had a car, I would drive you. » : l'interlocuteur a-t-il une voiture ? Justifie.
corrige: Le prétérit had a ici une valeur modale : il exprime l'irréel du présent, pas le passé.
La phrase sous-entend que la personne n'a pas de voiture.
exercices.reponse: Non : il n'a pas de voiture (irréel du présent, prétérit modal).

exercices.enonce: Explique la différence de sens : (a) « If he comes, I'll tell him. » (b) « If he came, I'd tell him. »
corrige: (a) Type 1 : sa venue est considérée comme possible, réelle.
(b) Type 2 : sa venue est envisagée comme peu probable ou imaginaire.
exercices.reponse: (a) venue jugée possible (type 1) ; (b) venue jugée improbable ou imaginaire (type 2).

exercices.enonce: Réécris en type 3 à la forme négative : « The team trained hard, so it won the final. »
corrige: On imagine le contraire du passé : trained → hadn't trained.
Conséquence inversée : won → wouldn't have won.
exercices.reponse: If the team hadn't trained hard, it wouldn't have won the final.

exercices.enonce: Lis ce court texte : « Tom overslept this morning. He missed his job interview. Now he is still unemployed. » Écris une phrase de type 3 et une phrase mixte passé → présent.
corrige: Type 3 (passé → passé) : If Tom hadn't overslept, he wouldn't have missed his job interview.
Mixte passé → présent : If he hadn't missed his job interview, he might not be unemployed now / he would have a job now.
exercices.reponse: If Tom hadn't overslept, he wouldn't have missed his job interview. / If he hadn't missed his interview, he would have a job now. (Exemple de réponse)

exercices.enonce: Lis la situation : « Lisa is very busy. She can't come to your party. Her brother keeps interrupting her. » Écris trois phrases avec wish : un regret présent, un agacement et un souhait au conditionnel de type 2.
corrige: Regret présent → wish + prétérit : I wish I weren't so busy.
Agacement → wish + would : I wish my brother would stop interrupting me.
Type 2 : If I weren't so busy, I would come to your party.
exercices.reponse: I wish I weren't so busy. / I wish my brother would stop interrupting me. / If I weren't so busy, I would come to your party. (Exemple de réponse)

exercices.enonce: Classe chaque phrase selon son sens (regret présent, regret passé, agacement) : (a) « I wish you would listen to me. » (b) « I wish I lived by the sea. » (c) « I wish I had listened to you. »
corrige: wish + would → agacement, souhait que l'autre change : (a).
wish + prétérit → regret présent : (b) ; wish + past perfect → regret passé : (c).
exercices.reponse: (a) agacement ; (b) regret présent ; (c) regret passé
